subject: Architecture
title: The 15-Minute City: Everything Nearby
description: A 60-second lesson on The 15-Minute City: Everything Nearby.

hook.text: What if you could reach work, school, shops, parks, and healthcare within a 15-minute walk or bike ride?

buildup.text: Professor Carlos Moreno proposed the '15-minute city' — redesigning neighborhoods so daily needs are local.

discovery.text: Paris is leading the experiment — converting car lanes to bike paths and adding greenery to every neighborhood.

twist.text: Critics call it social control — restricting movement by design. Supporters say it's freedom from car dependency.

climax.text: Barcelona's 'superblocks' close streets to cars, creating parks and plazas — reducing pollution by 25%.

punchline.text: The best commute is none. Design the city so you never leave.

quiz.question: What is the core idea of the 15-minute city?
options: All buildings should be within 15 minutes of a highway
Daily needs are reachable within a 15-minute walk or bike ride
Public transit should arrive every 15 minutes
